purpose: Design of reference checking and change-impact notification: formal reference extraction, directory scanning, hash comparison, inconsistency checks and detail file output.
summary: Formal references come from reference-link definitions whose title ends with a DLID, with an optional recorded content hash
Scripts scan the specified directory and classify results as match, path mismatch, or absent, plus fragment checks
Moved targets are searched within the current Index target list to give path-mismatch fix destinations
link_without_dlid reports include the value to write into the title, taken from current files
Reverse references are built from scanned sources and compared by recorded hash versus current hash
Impact candidates include references with no recorded hash and exclude indirect sources
Notification reads title records from source files and repeats until the project management AI rewrites them
doc-link never edits documents and holds no notification state
Inconsistency checks are split into check-dlid, check-links, check-toc and check-impact skills
Checks print counts to stdout and write full details to a detail file under .temp
tasks: Implementing reference extraction and link checking
Implementing check-dlid, check-links or check-toc detail file output
Defining the value to write into link titles
